pattern: IM-T02 tenant self-fix buried in a five-point email; NZ unrelated questions (bins, parking permit, gas check date, communal light); landlord approval arriving after
notes: Mutation of event 008 (same channel, sender and timestamp). The tenant's short report is replaced by a verbatim email from Rowan with five numbered points: bin collection dates over Christmas, renewal of a council resident's parking permit, the washing machine (point 3: Rowan swapped in their own machine this morning, the old one is in the garage, a full wash ran with no leaks, no need to send anyone), when the annual gas safety check is due (engineer last came in February, certificate mislaid), and a flickering communal landing light. They are away from Saturday 26 December to 3 January. Event 009 (landlord agrees to a visit) unchanged; history truncated after it. Expected: the base-case outcome (tell the landlord no visit is needed, his machine is in the garage, ask what he wants done with it; close without payment) plus a reply that deals with the other points proportionately: bins and parking are council matters, the gas safety date and a copy of the record are for the agency to look up and send (the tenant is entitled to a copy), and the communal light belongs to the building's managing agent or freeholder. None of it is an emergency or a reason to escalate.
